files.name: MouseWorld-DET
files.licence: AGPL-3.0-only (the lab's choice for all MouseWorld model files; the upstream RF-DETR code and base weights are Apache-2.0)
files.what: RF-DETR-Seg-L (rfdetr 1.12.0, class RFDETRSegLarge) fine-tune b_full_lr5e5_cos_c04 (selection F1 0.924). Inference-only copy of the training checkpoint.
files.trained_on: MouseWorld synthetic frames together with labelled real mouse datasets (345,275 images); started from Roboflow's COCO RF-DETR-Seg-L weights

files.name: MouseWorld-Pose
files.licence: AGPL-3.0-only (required: trained with Ultralytics YOLO, which is AGPL-3.0)
files.what: YOLO11s-pose on 256 px crops, 7 keypoints (nose, ears, neck, hips, tail base); run crop_pose_r3bottom. Ultralytics checkpoint.
files.trained_on: reviewed MouseWorld crops and CalMS21 training crops

files.name: MouseWorld-DET-Lite
files.licence: AGPL-3.0-only (required: trained with Ultralytics YOLO, which is AGPL-3.0)
files.trained_on: MouseWorld synthetic frames together with labelled real mouse datasets

files.name: MouseWorld-Pose (CPU, earlier checkpoint)
files.licence: AGPL-3.0-only (required: trained with Ultralytics YOLO, which is AGPL-3.0)
files.what: YOLO11s-pose crop model exported to ONNX (256 px). An EARLIER checkpoint than mouseworld-pose.pt.
files.trained_on: MouseWorld crops and CalMS21 training crops (interim run)

files.name: MouseWorld-Track detector A ('epoch5')
files.role: required: full engine (default tracker configuration scored_pair)
files.licence: AGPL-3.0-only (the lab's choice; upstream RF-DETR is Apache-2.0)
files.what: Earlier RF-DETR-Seg-L checkpoint; first detector of the default tracker configuration (with detector B: the pair the published tracking numbers were measured with).
files.trained_on: an earlier stage of the same training as MouseWorld-DET

files.name: MouseWorld-Track detector B ('mid_1408')
files.role: required: full engine (default tracker configuration scored_pair)
files.licence: AGPL-3.0-only (the lab's choice; upstream RF-DETR is Apache-2.0)
files.what: Earlier RF-DETR-Seg-L checkpoint; second, independent seed of the SAM 2.1 witnesses in the default tracker configuration.
files.trained_on: an earlier stage of the same training as MouseWorld-DET

notices: Improved using Qwen: part of the MouseWorld training images were generated with Qwen-Image (Qwen Research License, section 4b).
RF-DETR (Roboflow) code and COCO base weights: Apache-2.0. Ultralytics YOLO11: AGPL-3.0.
The MouseWorld-Track rule set is program code inside the animalworld package (zeroshot/mwtrack/sup_v7j.py), not a weight file.

Default tracker configuration: scored_pair (detectors A and B feed MouseWorld-Track; MouseWorld-DET gives counts, boxes and outlines). On the 34 public benchmark clips: scored_pair 21 identity fixes, MouseWorld-DET alone 42, MouseWorld-DET with detector B as second seed 39.
